panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: Bioluminescent light pulses through the cavern in waves, each pulse revealing more of the horror ahead. The Spiral Mycelium — a vast fungal intelligence — has woven itself into every surface, its fruiting bodies swaying in a rhythm that has no wind.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: The air is thick with spores. Each breath brings whispers — fragments of thoughts not your own. The Mycelium knows you are here. It has been waiting.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: The Spiral Mycelium convulses, its network of tendrils blackening and curling inward. The spore-light flickers and dies, replaced by clean sunlight filtering through cracks in the cavern ceiling.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: For the first time in months, the air tastes of earth and moss rather than spore-dreams. But beneath the dying fungus, you glimpse something — a thread of purple energy retreating deeper underground. The infection here was fed from elsewhere.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: The spores close in like a living fog. One by one, the heroes fall silent, their thoughts dissolving into the Mycelium's vast, alien awareness. The fungus feeds.
